**Product Title:** Smartwatch - AMOLED Display and Bluetooth Calling (₹4,999 or ₹5,499)

**Short Description:**
Upgrade your fitness and style with this feature-packed smartwatch. Equipped with an AMOLED display, Bluetooth calling, and IP68 water resistance, this smartwatch is perfect for fitness enthusiasts and tech-savvy individuals. Get up to 7-10 days of battery life on a single charge.

**Key Features:**

- AMOLED display in 1.78 or 1.9 inches
- Bluetooth calling for hands-free conversations
- IP68 water resistance for durability
- Up to 7-10 days of battery life
- 2GB or 4GB of storage for your data

**Detailed Description:**
Stay connected and on top of your fitness goals with this smartwatch. With its AMOLED display, you can view essential information like time, date, and notifications with crisp clarity. The built-in GPS (Connected GPS in the box) helps track your runs, hikes, and other outdoor activities with precision. The IP68 water resistance ensures that your smartwatch can withstand accidental splashes and drops. Plus, with Bluetooth calling, you can receive and make calls directly from your wrist.

**Specifications:**

- Display: AMOLED 1.78 or 1.9 inches
- Battery Life: Up to 7-10 days
- Storage: 2GB or 4GB
- GPS: Built-in (Connected GPS in the box)
- Features: Bluetooth calling, IP68 water resistance
